versions.subject: Change "reference" to "references" to match new schema
versions.detection:
keywords:
    # Oracle
    - quoted string not properly terminated
    # MySQL
    - You have an error in your SQL syntax
    # SQL Server
    - Unclosed quotation mark
    # SQLite
    - near "*": syntax error
    - SELECTs to the left and right of UNION do not have the same number of result columns
condition: keywords
versions.spl: "quoted string not properly terminated" OR "You have an error in your SQL syntax" OR "Unclosed quotation mark" OR "near "*""="syntax error" OR "SELECTs to the left and right of UNION do not have the same number of result columns"
